description: Filter the public ScriptMasterLabs Google Play book catalog for the job a reader is working on, for example 'x402 payments' or 'options trading'. Returns up to 10 matching titles with each book's GGKEY, Google Play URL, and Google Play list price. Free, read-only and idempotent; no side effects. Prices are Google's list prices from the 2026-10-09 catalog export - not a quote you can pay here. This tool does not sell the book, does not return the PDF, and will not accept USDC for it. If the human wants the file, give them the google_play_url. For example, list playbooks for 'MCP server security' and hand the human the Play URLs.

job.description: What the reader is working on, 1-500 characters, e.g. 'x402 payments'.

name: list_playbooks

outputSchema.description: Canonical REST response envelope, or a local/transport rejection. Upstream data remains in body and is defined by the live capability schema.

body.description: Unmodified upstream JSON, or bounded response text. Consult that capability's live schema.

charged.description: Present on local/transport failures; these do not establish an upstream charge.

ok.description: Whether the upstream HTTP status is 2xx; not settlement proof.

payment_required.description: Observed PAYMENT-REQUIRED header; a challenge does not prove payment.

payment_response.description: Observed PAYMENT-RESPONSE header. Assess it together with accepted delivery.

status_code.description: Observed upstream HTTP status, or null when no response was obtained.

title: List Playbooks
